notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Arry and Miri can now gain affection.
[*]The player can now view Arry and Miri's epilogue scenes. (You will have to answer their proposal one more time.)
[*]The Arry and Miri achievements have been fixed and should unlock when you reach the epilogue.
[*]The ability management backend has been 100% REDONE, and all associated bugs should be fixed.
[*]Specifically, ability use counts and levels will no longer reset if they're no longer in a player preset.

[h2]ACTION REQUIRED:[/h2]
If you take one thing from this update, it's that [b]Arry and Miri's[/b] conversation lines were [b]broken[/b] before this update, with all their epilogue scenes being [b]hidden[/b]. 

[b]If you've been stuck at their proposal, doing it one more time should unlock their achievements and lead you to their epilogue scenes.[/b]

Additionally, I've begun work on the logbook! It's coming along nicely.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FBdDow9.png[/img]

notes.title: Hearts of the Dungeon List has RELEASED!
notes.content:
The day has finally come!

[b]Hearts of the Dungeon List is now out on version 1.0.[/b]

This update comes with just a few changes to give the game that last little nudge!
[list]
[*]Achievements are now active! 
[*]A LITERAL TON of bug fixes!
[/list]
This has been a fun journey, but it's far from over!

[h2]Future Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Expanded Fishing (fishing log, RPG elements, etc.)
[*]Casino
[*]Over a dozen additional outfits (probably more than two dozen, I haven't counted)
[*]The full 200 monsters (Currently I think we're at ~120?)
[*]Challenging post-game dungeons
[*]Additional epilogue scenes for all three girls (6-9 currently, I plan to add a LOT more!)
[*]A few QoL features that I'd like to add
[*]Much more!
[/list]

[h3]A note on achievements:[/h3]
Achievements will be at best uncooperative with old saves, so to be safe I recommend a fresh save for 1.0. I'm sorry for the inconvenience but Achievements took me right up to the line so I had to prioritize bigger bugs over retroactive achievements.

tags.feature: Achievements are now active!

tags.bug: A LITERAL TON of bug fixes!

notes.title: Update v0.9
notes.content:
This is essentially the full game as it will appear in 1.0. 

With that said, there are some KNOWN BUGS that I'm currently working on, one of which could have a mild effect on certain player's experience;

[b]If an ability is not included on any of your ability presets, it's values will not be saved.[/b]
This means if you level up ability A to 10, then exchange it for move B, without move A being on any of your three preset lists, it will be reset to level 1.

I'm working on getting this fixed for Friday, but it's stemming from a larger architectural problem so it's taking a LOT of time and effort. I expect this will be fixed for Friday, but I wanted to warn those of you who wanted to play early so you could avoid it.

Moving on...

Changelog for v0.9:
[list]
[*]Additional story sequences (including prologues for each girl)
[*]Additional events
[*]Additional monsters
[*]Fixing effects and sfx have been redone
[*]Fishing UI has been overhauled, including fish images
[*]Each area type now has a unique BGM track
[*]Balancing has been redone
[*]Abilities have been reworked
[*]The final boss has been implemented
[*]Various UI adjustments
[*][i]Countless [/i]bugfixes
[*]More! 
[/list]

Steam achievements have also been added and will be activated Friday!

We're almost there!

-Nick

notes.title: Update v0.81
notes.content:
Update 0.81 marks the recommencement of development! 

Changelog
[list]
[*]Updated to Unity 2020
[*]Critical and dodge chances for player have drastically increased
[*]Framework for events now 100% in place
[*]First handful of events implemented with more partially implemented
[*]Reworked mission generator scales missions to your level
[/list]

Next up I'll be adding a big bundle of events and fixing up some event UI stuff. 

There's not much info about events around the game and I want to improve that as well. Currently they only show up every three battles of adventure and can be negative or positive, with a big lean towards positive.

After I'm happy with event stuff, I'll fix up the bestiary, implement affection/multiple endings, and we'll be approaching the game leaving early access!

Thanks everyone!
-Nick

notes.title: Update v0.77 - LARGE UPDATE!
notes.content:
This is the BIG one! A TON was changed here.

Changelist:
[list]
[*]The story content has more than doubled (story & personal)
[*]Total rework of abilities
[*]Total rework of DEX (no longer purely comparative, you will always see benefits from points into DEX)
[*]Two new characters appear in story scenes
[*]Total/partial reworks of various status effects (poison, heal, clear, stop)
[*]Various bugfixes
[/list]

Balancing is very different now and might need some polishing, but overall I'm very happy with the new changes. They allow the content to scale in a much more seamless way that will make balancing the end-game dungeons, abilities, and post-game dungeons MUCH easier!

Also, it probably goes without saying, but all the story content is still incomplete. I want to add the final parts of the story as the game leaves Early Access.

notes.title: Update v0.75
notes.content:
Fixing more bugs. This has a big one in it that probably affects your save.

There was a issue that caused any shop upgrades to not be saved. Because of this, after saving and loading, the projects and shop upgrade amount would be out of sync, causing you to miss out on higher level items and the kitchen. I've fixed the saving/loading bug, but saves older than this update will persist with the issue.

I plan to retroactively fix this, but it will take a bit more work and I wanted to get these fixes out asap. So if this is affecting you, you can start a new file or if you don't care too much, just give it some time for me to fix fully.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed saving/loading issue around shop upgrades
[*]Reworked bestiary lists to fix issue that soft-locked the game on the last 6 dungeons
[*]Defeating bosses > dungeon 50 will now reward the correct HP and MP
[*]Bosses all now show the warning sign and play boss music
[*]Slight ability adjustments in preparation for overhaul, shouldn't be noticeable
[/list]
